title: Work-In-Progress Feed for FLAIL
description: An upcoming short film about a pitiful, flabby sack of flesh getting bludgeoned by all the stress, doom, and dopamine traps of this day and age. Try to imagine Sisyphus happy.

modules.html: Testing some ideas for the ending when the perspective shifts to FPS mode and he experiences life more directly.
The assets are still WIP but the systems are coming together and its good seeing a longer sequence of rough animation to get a sense for how it all feels together.

title: PILE
description:
Water then food. Agriculture then industry. Old then new. Critical then extra.
Simple to complex. Concrete to abstract. Dirt to clouds. Real to unreal.
